rules.name: jurisdiction_code_edition_and_responsibility
rules.requirement: The approving authority, project jurisdiction, applicable code and standard editions, design stage, licensed responsibility and submission requirements shall be explicit before civil geometry is generated.
rules.prevention: Block production-stage generation when jurisdiction, edition, scope or responsible-discipline authority is unresolved; generic defaults and image references are not authority.

rules.name: survey_control_coordinate_reference_and_units
rules.requirement: Horizontal datum, vertical datum, coordinate reference system, geoid/model, survey control points, units, scale factor and transformation method shall be source-bound and internally consistent.
rules.prevention: Require hash-bound survey control and an independently checked transformation report; never infer coordinates or elevation from pixels.

rules.name: existing_conditions_and_topographic_freshness
rules.requirement: Existing terrain, structures, utilities, water features, boundaries and access constraints shall identify acquisition method, accuracy class, date and known gaps.
rules.prevention: Expire stale existing-condition evidence and expose uncertainty zones rather than silently interpolating unsupported conditions.

rules.name: property_right_of_way_and_easement_authority
rules.requirement: Property lines, rights-of-way, easements, setbacks and legal access shall be bound to controlled survey or legal records and shall not be reconstructed from aerial imagery alone.
rules.prevention: Keep legal geometry in a protected authority layer and block conflicts or unproved offsets before design layout.

rules.name: geotechnical_and_groundwater_design_basis
rules.requirement: Soil profile, groundwater, bearing, settlement, slope stability, pavement subgrade and earthwork assumptions shall come from current geotechnical evidence or remain explicit blockers.
rules.prevention: Do not substitute visual terrain appearance or generic soil properties for project geotechnical inputs.

rules.name: design_criteria_and_operating_envelope
rules.requirement: Traffic, loading, design life, climate, rainfall, flood, seismic, maintenance, emergency and construction-stage criteria shall be frozen with units and sources.
rules.prevention: Maintain one design-basis ledger and invalidate dependent checks whenever a criterion or source revision changes.

rules.name: horizontal_vertical_alignment_and_continuity
rules.requirement: Alignments, profiles, grades, curves, transitions, stations and tie-ins shall be mathematically continuous, uniquely constrained and checked against the controlled coordinate system.
rules.prevention: Use typed alignment primitives and continuity checks; reject disconnected, reversed-station or self-intersecting geometry.

rules.name: grading_drainage_and_no_trapped_surface
rules.requirement: Finished surfaces, spot levels, breaklines, slopes, flow paths, inlets, outlets and overflow routes shall form a coherent drainage model with no unexplained trapped low points.
rules.prevention: Run surface topology, minimum/maximum grade, ponding, inlet capture and safe-overflow checks after every grading change.

rules.name: hydrology_hydraulics_and_outfall_authority
rules.requirement: Catchments, rainfall source, return periods, runoff parameters, tailwater, storage, conveyance, freeboard and outfall permissions shall be traceable to the selected authority and calculation model.
rules.prevention: Bind every plotted hydraulic result to model inputs and scenario IDs; a pipe label or visual slope is not hydraulic proof.

rules.name: utility_identity_separation_and_crossing_coordination
rules.requirement: Each existing and proposed utility shall have typed service identity, material, size, level, ownership, protection, separation, crossing and maintenance-access requirements.
rules.prevention: Run three-dimensional conflict and access-envelope checks across all utilities; unresolved records remain uncertainty blockers.

rules.name: road_accessibility_and_safety_geometry
rules.requirement: Road, path, curb, ramp, crossing, sight-distance, vehicle-envelope, pedestrian, cycle and accessibility geometry shall be checked against the selected project criteria and user classes.
rules.prevention: Use swept paths, slope/crossfall matrices and accessible-route continuity rather than isolated nominal dimensions.

rules.name: earthwork_material_balance_and_unsuitable_material
rules.requirement: Existing/proposed surface versions, stripping, bulking/shrinkage, unsuitable material, borrow/disposal and quantity boundaries shall be explicit and reproducible.
rules.prevention: Bind quantity reports to exact surface hashes and calculation regions; reject unclosed regions and mixed revisions.

rules.name: erosion_sediment_environmental_and_water_controls
rules.requirement: Construction and permanent erosion, sediment, pollution, habitat, water-quality and permit controls shall be coordinated with grading and phasing.
rules.prevention: Require stage-specific control drawings and inspection/maintenance access before exposing construction candidates.

rules.name: cross_discipline_interface_and_clash_closure
rules.requirement: Civil interfaces with structure, architecture, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, landscape, fire, rail and process disciplines shall use shared coordinates, controlled clearances and an exact issue ledger.
rules.prevention: A resolved issue is removed only after all affected models and drawings are rechecked against the same source revisions.

rules.name: constructability_temporary_works_access_and_phasing
rules.requirement: Construction access, plant envelopes, temporary support, excavation, dewatering, traffic staging, tie-ins, shutdowns and safe sequencing shall be represented or explicitly assigned to responsible design evidence.
rules.prevention: Do not treat the final geometry as proof that intermediate construction states are feasible or safe.

rules.name: materials_specifications_and_inspection_characteristics
rules.requirement: Material classes, workmanship, compaction, testing, tolerances, acceptance methods and inspection lots shall be linked to drawing objects and current specifications.
rules.prevention: Require object-to-specification and object-to-inspection mappings; notes without measurable acceptance criteria do not close the gate.

rules.name: plans_profiles_sections_details_and_annotation_closure
rules.requirement: Plans, profiles, cross-sections, details, schedules, coordinates, levels, slopes, stations, legends, notes, scales, sheet IDs and revision references shall form a complete stage-appropriate drawing set.
rules.prevention: Validate a declared sheet matrix and cross-reference graph; model geometry alone is not a civil deliverable.

rules.name: digital_exchange_landxml_gis_and_native_host_persistence
rules.requirement: Required DWG/DXF/LandXML/IFC/GIS/native files shall preserve units, coordinates, surfaces, alignments, attributes, layer semantics and source hashes through save/reopen or independent re-import.
rules.prevention: Run format-specific round trips and compare typed object inventories, coordinates and hashes before native/exchange claims.

rules.name: independent_calculation_model_and_drawing_parity_review
rules.requirement: Critical calculations, models, quantities and drawings shall be independently checked for exact input, scenario, object and revision parity; one passing discipline check cannot offset another missing check.
rules.prevention: Use an exact coverage ledger with named evidence for every required gate and invalidate affected rows after any source change.

rules.name: field_setting_out_asbuilt_and_release_authority
rules.requirement: Setting-out data, construction issue status, hold points, as-built capture, deviations, approvals and final release shall remain separated and controlled by the responsible authority.
rules.prevention: Generated coordinates and drawings remain review candidates until field control, independent review and authorized issue evidence are complete.
